## Three countries: Rio, Iguaçu, Buenos Aires and Santiago

After Iguaçu, the next stretch of the itinerary takes you to Buenos Aires. It includes a city tour, a tango show, free days, a trip to Tigre and the option of visiting Montevideo or an Argentine ranch.

The final days are in Santiago, Chile. A city tour of the capital is included, with optional trips to the Maipo Valley wine region and Valparaíso.

Over 15 days, the pace changes several times. Rio combines beaches, mountains and a historic centre, then Iguaçu shifts the focus to nature. Buenos Aires leaves more time to explore the city and take day trips. The journey ends in Santiago, with views of the Andes and the option to visit a wine region or the coast.
